limitations: These camera clips are descriptive visual comparisons from one approved trajectory production, not independent repeats or an equal-time quality benchmark.
GPU timing is a separate deterministic image-free replay of the same frames, not measured during MP4 playback.
The first GPU smoothing windows contain fewer than 15 captured frames.
The source MP4s are already lossy. Full views are reduced by 3:1 and crops use native source resolution; no added tone mapping or denoising.
A fixed screen-space crop follows image coordinates, not the same world-space surface during camera motion.
